name: bleh block CFG
plain: Applies a CFG-like step inside the UNet on the block features of the batch, not on the output. Applied at chosen input, middle and output blocks during a sigma window. A positive scale moves the chosen half away from the other half.
math: h_p←h_p−k(h_p−h_s), p=cond half (or uncond if apply_to is not cond), s the other half; only when both are in the batch.
label: from code
surprise: check_applies still has a debug tqdm.write on every call; apply_cfg_fun_ above it is an unfinished stub that computes a diff and returns nothing.
